name: Convento
source:
Follow a group of players who meet in an online game. They have different situations, but end up with a common goal, to exploit a loophole and make a living playing videogames.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816590/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
跟随一群在网络游戏中相遇的玩家。他们的处境各不相同，但最终都有一个共同的目标：钻漏洞，靠玩电子游戏谋生。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816590/]Steam[/url]]
